blocks.text: The Reach is what remains of the old kingdom of **Maro** after the sea took two-thirds of it in a single generation. Drowned towers still break the surface at low tide, and every harbor town grew fat on what washes ashore.

Its largest surviving port is [[Port Vellen]], seat of what passes for law here. The [[The Tidewardens|Tidewardens]] patrol the shipping lanes, though smugglers like [[Kestrel Vane]] treat their patrol routes as a timetable.
The drowning began with [[The Drowning War]] in 988 AR — scholars still argue whether the sea rose in anger or was *called*. See also the [[Founding of Port Vellen]].
The sea was called. The ritual that sank Maro was performed with [[The Hollow Crown]], and [[The Veiled Hand]] intends to finish the job. No player should learn this until Act 3.
